integrity.proof_basis: Schur complement, block inversion, connector dominance, sign comparison, and quadratic root bounds
integrity.reproducibility: verify_bridge.py uses standard-library rational arithmetic; finite checks supplement rather than replace universal proof
integrity.scientific_origin: Literature-motivated analytical finding; no external validation implied
integrity.scope: Finite nonnegative symmetric adjacency matrices and exact rational graph calculations

scientific_limitations: Theorem applies to a homogeneous symmetric-contact linearized SIS/NIMFA spectral threshold, not the exact absorbing finite stochastic epidemic or nonlinear prevalence.
One weighted intercommunity edge; no multi-edge, directed or heterogeneous-curing extension asserted.
A recipient network with large spectral radius may restrict the admissible recovery/transmission domain and hide an intrinsic crossover.
Prior-art coverage is best-knowledge and does not certify publication priority.
title: A sharp clique–star crossover law for outbreak-critical bridge placement
